audience: newsletter authors who send email with Buttondown

useCases.title: See how a newsletter email performed
useCases.text: The AI reads recipients, deliveries, opens, clicks, unsubscriptions and complaints for a sent email, and compares it with other emails.

useCases.title: Find and review subscribers
useCases.text: The AI lists or searches subscribers by email text, type, tag, signup date or domain, with open and click rates, and opens one subscriber.

useCases.title: Add a subscriber or change tags and notes
useCases.text: The AI adds one subscriber by email, or updates a subscriber's tags, private note or metadata.

useCases.title: Write or edit an email draft
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft email with subject and body, or edits a draft. Nothing is sent; you send it in Buttondown.

useCases.title: Review automations and surveys
useCases.text: The AI lists automations and reads their performance, and lists surveys with their responses.

useCases.title: Compare tags by engagement
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriber tags and reads the number of new subscribers, the open rate and the click rate for a tag.
